facts.conditions: Section 7.3 and 7.5 recommended operating conditions apply together. Threshold blanks are not zero bounds: footnote assures VIT+ is at least VHYS above VIT- under specific conditions. Both individual-pin/common-mode and differential constraints must hold. Ambient -40..125 C, junction -40..150 C; account for self-heating. Absolute maximum, transient and ESD ratings do not extend normal operation or prove board IEC/isolation compliance.

facts.conditions: HVD75 bus-current rows require DE=0 V, VCC=3..3.6 V or 0 V. D/DE/RE logic levels require powered recommended operation; no arbitrary controller compatibility follows. value.DE_high: Driver follows D: D high gives A high/B low; D low reverses polarity.
value.D_open_with_DE_high: Internal pullup selects A high/B low.

facts.conditions: RE denotes the active-low receiver enable. Standby current row requires DE=GND, RE=VCC, D open and no load, over recommended conditions. Receiver-enabled driver-disabled operation is not standby. Control pin thresholds, actual output loading and supply remain relevant; tri-state does not prove bus release scheduling or contention avoidance.

value.enabled_receiver_open_short_idle: High output for disconnected bus, A-B short, or idle terminated bus.
value.threshold_behavior: VID=VA-VB above VIT+ selects high; below VIT- selects low; between thresholds is indeterminate.
value.noise_example: Section 9.3 describes bus-idle or bus-short with VIT+=-20 mV and VHYS=50 mV maintaining high with 140 mV peak-to-peak differential noise.

facts.conditions: Receiver must be enabled (RE low) and operating voltage limits satisfied. An A-B short is not a short to arbitrary power or ground. The bounded noise example does not establish immunity to arbitrary noise, ground shift, transients or missing/incorrect termination; external bias suitability remains application dependent. No universal no-bias guarantee follows.

source_issues.description: Actual cable impedance/length/stubs/topology, termination placement and tolerances, node loading and bias network are unspecified. Bus loading, failsafe and typical topology facts do not validate a complete network.

Controller logic thresholds, output loading, supply sequencing, data rate, cable delay, DE/RE scheduling and turnaround/sample budget are unspecified. Neither 20 Mbps nor propagation/enable maxima proves collision-free communication.

Ground offset, individual bus-pin waveform, differential noise, transient exposure, protection circuit and isolation needs are unspecified. Normal operating, absolute-maximum and component ESD tests are distinct; no board-level IEC/EMC qualification or arbitrary fault survival is established.
